definitions.short: properly, the hind part ; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses)
definitions.usage: after (that, -ward), again, at, away from, back (from, -side), behind, beside, by, follow (after, -ing), forasmuch, from, hereafter, hinder end, + out (over) live, + persecute, posterity, pursuing, remnant, seeing, since, thence(-forth), when, with.
definitions.full: H310. achar אַחַר properly substantive the hinder or following part (compare the plural) 1. adverb a. of place, behind, twice Gen 22:13 (many MSS. ᵑ6 ᵐ5 ⅏ Ol Ew read אֶחָד see Di) Psa 68:26 . b. of time, afterwards Gen 10:18 ; 18:5 ; 24:55 ; 30:21 ; Judg 19:5 +; וְאַחַר in laws of P, as Lev 14:8 , 19 ; 15:28 ; 22:7 ; Num 5:26 and elsewhere 2. preposition a. of place, behind, after Exod 3:1 ; 11:5 ; 2Kin 11:6 ; Song 2:9 ; Isa 57:8 : אַחַר הָלַח to go after, follow Gen 37:17 ; 2Kin 13:2 ; 23:3 ; Isa 65:2 ; Ezek 13:3 ; Job 31:7 ; אַחַר חָיָה 1Sam 12:14 ; מֵאַחַר from after 2Sam 7:8 ; Psa 78:71 ; Isa 59:13 . b. of time, after Gen 9:28 ; Lev 25:15 al; הַדְּבָרִים אַחַר הָאֵלֶּה after these things Gen 15:1 ; 22:1 ; 39:7 ; 40:1 ; 1Kin 17:17 ; 21:1 ; Ezra 7:1 ; Est 2:1 ; 3:1 ; כֵּן אַחַר Lev 14:36 ; Deut 21:13 ; 1Sam 10:5 ; זֶה אַחַר (late) 2Chr 32:9 ; followed by infinitive Num 6:19 ; Jer 40:1 ; 1Chr 2:24 ; Job 21:3 ; אַחַר עַד till after Neh 13:19 . c. Neh 5:15 strangely: Ew RV besides ; but text probably corrupt, see Be Ry. 3 conjunction אֲשֶׁר אַחַר after that Ezek 40:1 ; and without אשׁר Lev 14:43 ; Jer 41:16 ; Job 42:7 . As preposition & conjunction the plural אַחֲרֵי is much more frequently, which in any case must be used before suffixes. Plural only construct אַחֲרֵי with suffix אַחֲרֶיךָ אַחֲרַי, , etc. 1. substantive hinder part 2Sam 2:23 הַחֲנִית בְּאַחֲרֵי with the hinder end of the spear. 2. preposition a. of place, behind, after Gen 18:10 אַחֲרָיו וְהוּא and it behind him Deut 11:30 ; Judg 5:14 ; 1Sam 14:13 ; 21:10 ; Hosea 5:8 אַחֲרֶיךָ Behind thee! (sc. Look or The foe is); with a verbas הִבִּיט to look Gen 19:17 ; 1Sam 24:9 , ראֹשׁ הֵנִיעַ to shake the head 2Kin 19:21 ( = Isa 37:22 ), especially verbs expressing or implying motion, as בָּא to enter in (see Dr 2Sam 20:14 ) הִשְׁלִיח רָדַף, מָּנָה, מִלֵּא, הָלַח, הָיָה, דָּלַק, דָּבֵק, בִּעֵר, (see these words). b. of time , after Gen 9:9 אַחֲרֵיכֶם זַרְעֲכֶם your seed after you; similarly 17:7-10 , 19 ; 35:12 ; 48:4 ; Exod 28:43 ; Num 25:13 all P (also Deut 1:8 ; 4:37 ; 10:15 ; 1Sam 24:22 ; 2Sam 7:12 ||), & with בָּנָיו Gen 18:19 J ( + בֵּיתוֺ ) Exod 29:29 P Lev 25:46 H Deut 4:40 ; 12:25 , 28 ; Jer 32:18 , 39 ; 1Chr 28:8 ; Prov 20:7 , דּוֺרוֺתֵינוּ Josh 22:27 , בֵּיתוֺ Job 21:21 ; Exod 10:14 ; Judg 10:3 etc.; with infinitive Gen 5:4 הוֺלִידֹוֺ אַחֲרֵי after his begetting Sheth, 13:14 ; 14:17 ; 18:12 ; 25:11 + often; אַחֲרֵיכֵֿן afterwards 6:4 ( אשׁר כן אחרי = afterwards, when , compare 2Chr 35:20 ) Gen 15:14 ; 23:18 ; 25:26 ; 32:21 ; 41:31 ; 45:15 etc.; אחריכֿן ויהי as a formula of transition chiefly in 2Samuel ( 2Sam 2:1 ; 8:1 || 10:1 || 13:1 ; 21:18 ||) compare 1Sam 24:6 ; Judg 16:4 ; 2Kin 6:24 ; 2Chr 20:1 ; 24:4 ; in late Hebrew זֹאת אַחֲרֵי Job 42:16 ; Ezra 9:10 ; 2Chr 21:18 ( + כָּלֿ 35:20 (do.); compare Aramaic דְנָה אַחֲרֵי Dan 2:29 , 45 , and דְּנָה בָּאתַר 7:6-7 ,. — The local (metaphor) and temporal senses blend Psa 49:14 יִרְצוּ בְּפִיהֶם וְאַחֲרֵיהֶם & after them (i.e. following, imitating them) men applaud their speech, compare Job 21:33 . 3. conjunction אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵי after that, with the finite verb Deut 24:4 ; Josh 7:8 ; 9:16 ; 23:1 ; 24:20 +; without אשׁר Lev 25:48 ; 1Sam 5:9 .
